Subject: POC outcomes + quick ask: brief quote or 10-min sync

Hi Patricia —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. Short recap of what we observed on the workload you shared: 

- Inference latency: 95th percentile fell from ~420ms (baseline) to ~230ms on average after model/quantization tuning.
- Cost: estimated per-1M-token unit cost reduced by ~38% due to batching and KV-prefix caching configurations.
- Accuracy: reranking precision on the holdout set improved by +3.4 percentage points vs the initial model variant.

I've attached the one-page POC_results_summary.pdf and a dashboard snapshot for the week following the rollout. Karthik and I are both copied.

Quick ask: would you be willing to: 
1) Share a 1–2 line blurb we can use as a short customer quote (e.g., impact + one metric), or
2) Do a 10–12 minute call to record a 30–60 second clip / confirm a short quote?

Either option would be super helpful as we put together a short case highlight for other fintech teams. If you prefer a quick call, here are a couple of windows that work for us: Wed 10/6 9:30–10:00 PT or Thu 10/7 1:00–1:30 PT.

Thanks — really appreciate your partnership.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
